title: Red Velvet Papi's talent is on full display in the release of his recent song, "Too Much Love"
htmlContent:
Fast Rising New York-based music star Red Velvet Papi is a multi-faceted singer, rapper, songwriter, and producer making waves in the music industry. Red Velvet Papi brings you his recent song, "Too Much Love," a refreshing song that captures the sound of hope, love, and care in some of the best ways possible.

Red Velvet Papi's "Too Much Love" is about having a relationship where despite how much you love them, it's taking its toll on you and causing you mental angst. Red Velvet Papi continues to work towards making the best music he possibly can and building an extensive catalog that his current and future fans will be able to enjoy for years to come.
